import hashlib
import time

def validate_reset_token(token, stored_hash, timestamp, expiry_hours=24):
    current_time = time.time()
    token_age = current_time - timestamp
    max_age = expiry_hours * 3600
    
    if token_age > max_age:
        return False
    
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest()
    
    if token_hash == stored_hash:
        return True
    
    return False
fix_rationale: Changed the comparison operator on line 13 from != to == so the function returns True when the token hash matches the stored hash, and False when it doesn't match.
